verses.1: Redi’u wushbi al-afar, be’tulat Bat-Bavel. Shvi’layarot – there is no covering for the sick ones. For they will not call you “racha” or “vengeance”.
verses.2: Take my breath and blow it onto the ground. Let my spirit rest in peace. May rivers flow freely along your path.
verses.3: Your evil will be revealed, and your humiliation will be seen. I will take revenge, and I will not harm anyone.
verses.4: Our God, the Lord of hosts, whose name is holy to Israel.
verses.5: May they dwell in darkness, in the depths of despair. For they will not call upon your name as their queen among the kings.
verses.6: I have slandered my people; I have despoiled their land. I have given them over to your hands, and you have shown no mercy to them. You have treated them with cruelty.
verses.7: And I said to myself, “May it ever remain a great nation. Until those things are written in your heart, you will never remember them.”
verses.8: And now, hear this carefully: “I and Apsey will not sit down in darkness anymore. I won’t know what will happen next.”
verses.9: And two of these people will come to you on the same day. They will be all together, and they will come upon you with their whole strength. They will attack you completely, along with many of your friends.
verses.10: And I swore in your name, but you said, “My wisdom does not exist.” Your knowledge is nothing but nonsense. In my heart, I said, “I am lost again.”
verses.11: And evil will come upon you. You won’t know what kind of evil it is. It will fall upon you suddenly. You won’t be able to escape it.
verses.12: Please stand with your friends. And when you’re tired from your childhood, I will comfort you. Or else, I will help you.
verses.13: In your great wisdom, please stand up and help me. The wise men in the heavens will announce to me what will happen next.
verses.14: Look, they were like pieces of fire that couldn’t save their souls from the flames. There was no hope for them; they were trapped in the darkness, with no way out.
verses.15: So, if you were to go where your youth has left you behind, no one will be able to save you.
